title.zh: Metaplanet发行520亿日元零息可转债，用于偿还比特币担保借款及回购股份
title.en: Metaplanet发行520亿日元零息可转债，用于偿还比特币担保借款及回购股份

current_state.zh: Metaplanet拟发行520亿日元零息可转债（2031年到期），其中最多283亿日元用于股票回购（含最多253亿日元场外大宗交易，涉及约7.1%股份），约236亿日元用于偿还信贷并释放抵押比特币，无直接用于增持BTC的收益。
current_state.en: Metaplanet plans to issue ¥52B zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2031, with up to ¥28.3B for share buybacks (including up to ¥25.3B via off-exchange block for ~7.1% of shares) and ~¥23.6B to repay credit lines and release pledged bitcoin; no proceeds directly for additional BTC purchases.

updates.title_zh: Metaplanet发行520亿日元零息可转债，用于偿还比特币担保借款及回购股份

updates.what_changed_zh: Metaplanet宣布发行520亿日元零息可转换债券，2031年10月到期，其中236亿日元用于偿还比特币抵押借款，最多283亿日元用于股票回购，没有资金直接用于额外购买比特币。
updates.what_changed_en: Metaplanet announced a ¥52B zero-coupon convertible bond maturing October 2031, using ¥23.6B to repay bitcoin-backed borrowings and up to ¥28.3B for share buybacks, with no proceeds going directly to additional BTC purchases.

updates.title_zh: Metaplanet拟发行520亿日元零息可转债，部分用于偿还信贷并释放抵押比特币
updates.title_en: Metaplanet拟发行520亿日元零息可转债，部分用于偿还信贷并释放抵押比特币
updates.what_changed_zh: 新增细节：最多283亿日元回购中，最多253亿日元将通过场外大宗交易执行，涉及最多96,934,800股，约占已发行股份7.1%；约236亿日元用于部分偿还信贷额度以释放抵押比特币；CEO表示可转债初始转股价高于发行时股价及1.0倍mNAV，旨在以无担保无定期利息债务替代部分有担保计息借款，降低利息成本并提升后续增持比特币的财务灵活性。
updates.what_changed_en: Added details: of the up to ¥28.3B buyback, up to ¥25.3B will be via off-exchange block trade for up to 96,934,800 shares (~7.1% of outstanding); ~¥23.6B to partially repay credit lines and release pledged bitcoin; CEO states conversion price above issuance price and 1.0x mNAV, aiming to replace secured interest-bearing borrowings with unsecured non-interest debt, lower interest costs, and increase flexibility for future BTC purchases.
updates.current_state_zh: Metaplanet拟发行520亿日元零息可转债（2031年到期），其中最多283亿日元用于股票回购（含最多253亿日元场外大宗交易，涉及约7.1%股份），约236亿日元用于偿还信贷并释放抵押比特币，无直接用于增持BTC的收益。
updates.current_state_en: Metaplanet plans to issue ¥52B zero-coupon convertible bonds due 2031, with up to ¥28.3B for share buybacks (including up to ¥25.3B via off-exchange block for ~7.1% of shares) and ~¥23.6B to repay credit lines and release pledged bitcoin; no proceeds directly for additional BTC purchases.
updates.detailed_summary_zh: Metaplanet announced a ¥52 billion zero-coupon yen-denominated convertible bond due 2031, using up to ¥28.3 billion to buy back shares (including a ¥25.3 billion off-exchange block for ~7.1% of shares) and about ¥23.6 billion to repay credit lines and free up bitcoin held as collateral.
updates.detailed_summary_en: Metaplanet announced a ¥52 billion zero-coupon yen-denominated convertible bond due 2031, using up to ¥28.3 billion to buy back shares (including a ¥25.3 billion off-exchange block for ~7.1% of shares) and about ¥23.6 billion to repay credit lines and free up bitcoin held as collateral.
